title: Structural Research Harness — model-facing capability surface
description: Inject into agent instructions so automation knows which tools exist and when to use each subsystem.

subsystems.summary: Acquire and publish admitted evidence releases; inspect catalogs under Data/harvester/exports/.
subsystems.when_to_use: Need release IDs, catalog paths, provenance for evidence admitted into the framework.

subsystems.summary: Read-only evidence archive for the falsified Deformation v1 host theory.
subsystems.when_to_use: Inspect historical evidence and falsification records only; never run, publish, or promote v1.

subsystems.summary: Neutral funding-mismatch and market-constraint gauges with no Deformation theory authority.
subsystems.when_to_use: Produce or inspect the bounded daily pressure measurement.

subsystems.summary: Governance memory: events, health, improvement queue, routing decision audit trail.
subsystems.when_to_use: Record gaps, boundary breaches, or follow improvement items — not for promoting snapshots.

subsystems.summary: Governed Data/Output state transitions, including snapshot promotion preflight and release-mode promotion gate.
cli_entrypoints: system tools run artifact.promote_snapshot_preflight run_id=<RUN> --mode verify --json
system tools run artifact.promote_snapshot run_id=<RUN> --mode release --json
subsystems.when_to_use: Use preflight before promotion; actual promotion is a high-risk ToolSpec that requires release mode and manual review.

subsystems.summary: Convert fuzzy user requests into module ownership, context files, expert activation, mode, task plans, and verification expectations.
cli_entrypoints: system tools run routing.route_task task="..." --mode explore --json
system tools run routing.create_task_plan task="..." --mode explore --json
subsystems.when_to_use: Use before broad or ambiguous work so the agent starts from the smallest owning module, records escalation reasons, gets a ToolSpec-bound checklist, and can see missing ToolSpec coverage.

subsystems.summary: Governed tools with policy hooks (pre_tool_use / post_tool_use).
subsystems.when_to_use: Any mutation or subsystem action must go through registered tools and allowed modes.

workspace_commands.purpose: Human cockpit over Output/current without importing framework code.
Inspect archived Deformation evidence; canonical promotion is denied.

policy_enforcement: Compiled task routing, registered tools, runtime gates, schemas, hooks, and tests; no global reading list.
